_comment: Configure all output paths for qml-researcher skills.
Set output_root to the qml-artifacts repo path on the current machine.
Skills write Layer 1 sources here; /extract-artifacts populates cards/ and indexes/.
Set experiments_root to the qml_experiments repo path on the current machine.
The /qml-experiments skill reads it for context (what's been run, verdicts, status)
and can rerun / edit code there directly. That repo stays the source of truth for
code, data, and figures — never copy them into qml_artifacts (see experiment_card_schema.md).
